name: How do I decide between a cosmetic update and a full interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I decide between a cosmetic update and a full interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cosmetic refresh focuses on visual finishes like new paint, baseboards, or fixture swaps, whereas a full remodel involves reconfiguring layouts, structural framing, or replacing underlying surfaces. The main decision factor is your budget and whether your current floor plan meets your daily needs. If your room's flow is awkward or materials are damaged behind walls, a full renovation is the better route. Cosmetic changes are faster and lower cost, but they cannot solve issues like poor lighting placement, lack of closet framing, or damaged subfloors that require hands-on carpentry.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose cosmetic updates for quick aesthetic refreshes on sound layouts. Opt for a full remodel if you need to alter wall framing, update sub-trades, or fix underlying structural wear.
